title: Degree one of the scalar-reduced trace on the canonical Chern summand
statement: Let l be prime and let Y and P=ProjectiveLine Y be Noetherian schemes, with DiagonalTraceLocalizations at l. Fix a finite intermediate l-adic field E, a maximal-ideal generator pi, and a natural n. Give l-adic and integral coefficient Diagrams zl and integral, and ScalarCompatibility toIntegral along integralMap l E [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars]. Give tq:DiagonalTrace.Result for q:P→Y, with tq.model.model the identity [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation]. Give CompletedRealizations completedY, completedP, a full-unit CompletedPushSquare from tq.Rc to zl.Rq and CompletedTraceCompatibility identifying tq.trace with zl.traceq [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Put A=ULift(O_E/(pi^(n+1))), assume A finite and killed by l^(n+1), and assume l^(n+1) invertible on Y. Give a quotient Diagram d and ScalarCompatibility from integral to d. Give finite realizations eY,eP, a root-normalized QuotientLineRealization lineP at exponent n+1, and a FiniteTracePresentation p [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line, def-diagonal-finite-arrow-equations]. Let t=p.realizedTrace be d.traceq transported to the canonical finite pushforward and unit [lem-diagonal-finite-trace-chern-criterion]. Then biprod.inr followed by geoP1TwistedMap followed by t is the identity of the finite unit A_Y. This only compares the Chern composite, an endomorphism of A_Y. It has no diagonal completed arrow, Family, Reference, no conditions on the completed diagonal surface, and no conclusion about the other summand or the entire trace.

source.place: paragraph (1), reduction of the trace; trace proof paragraph (1), inverse positive unit/Chern splitting

proof.text: Derive l invertible from hYpow. Lift the strict-system Chern adjunct to a normalized completed arrow c.

The twisted-splitting component equation identifies the model Chern adjunct with the second injection into the twisted splitting. Composing with the inverse-splitting trace cancels the splitting and gives identity. Restriction, the varying direct-image isomorphism, and Rlim preserve this identity. Using c normalization and tq.construction proves that the constant-scalar image of c followed by tq.trace is identity; faithfulness on the degree-zero completed unit proves c followed by tq.trace is identity.
Use the finite Chern normalization to identify F(c) followed by the prescribed pushforward comparison v with the unit comparison u followed by the canonical finite Chern adjunct.

Compose q_trace, toIntegral.q.trace, scalar.q.trace and the defining equation of presentation.realizedTrace using functoriality. This gives F(tq.trace) followed by u equal to v followed by realizedTrace. Substitute both comparisons into F(c followed by tq.trace)=identity, then cancel the isomorphism u to obtain FiniteTraceChernDegree.

proof_origin.note: Use the whole-system Chern/trace identity and full-faithfulness to lift the Chern adjunct. Formal trace transport is proved; the sole remaining hole is the trace-independent finite Chern-arrow normalization.

theorem diagonalUniformizer_traceChernDegree
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    (zl : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y (zlLine l))
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    (integral : Diagram (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) Y
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E))
    (toIntegral : ScalarCompatibility (integralMap l E) Y (zlLine l)
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (integralLineMap l E) zl integral)
    (tq : DiagonalTrace.Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))
    (completedY : CompletedRealization l Y)
    (completedP : CompletedRealization l (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (q_model : tq.model.model = Iso.refl (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (q_square : CompletedPushSquare l (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
      completedP completedY tq.Rc zl.Rq)
    (q_trace : CompletedTraceCompatibility l (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
      completedP completedY tq zl.Rq q_square zl.traceq)
    [hfinite : Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))]
    (hA : ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) = 0)
    (hYpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      Y (quotientLine l E π n))
    (scalar : ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
      (quotientLineMap l E π n) integral d)
    (eY : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) Y)
    (eP : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (lineP : QuotientLineRealization l E π n n hA (ProjectiveLine Y) eP)
    (presentation : FiniteTracePresentation
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (l ^ (n + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA Y hYpow
      (quotientLine l E π n) d eY eP) :
    FiniteTraceChernDegree
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (l ^ (n + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA Y hYpow
      (quotientLine l E π n) d eY eP (lineP.iso l) presentation
